targets.outcome_reasoning: Abstract explicitly reports replicating alcohol effects but names no original paper or uniquely bounded set of papers. It does not establish which findings from which original were re-tested, so a per-original verdict cannot be assigned. An unresolved target placeholder represents missing identification, not a claim that only one original exists.

reasoning: Exact title, DOI and twelve authors verified. DOI landing and PDF endpoint return abstract/access options, not article body; OpenAlex and Unpaywall report no OA location; Europe PMC has no full text. Publisher reference list includes multiple Climate Schools trials and follow-ups (including Champion 2015, Newton 2009/2010 and Teesson 2017), none explicitly linked to the abstract replication statement. Cannot establish target count or independently code each original from this evidence. No candidate was promoted solely because it studies the same program. Overall abstract support for alcohol effects does not settle every unidentified original, cannabis or alcohol-harm finding.
